title: Couldn't be better.
text: Juanjo is a reference if you want to know the history of Holy Week. He knows the details of this identity marvel of Seville like few others. In addition, he takes you through the streets with knowledge and certainty, something very difficult to achieve on a night like the madrugá, where crowds abound everywhere and if you don't know the city, you get lost easily or get trapped. I highly recommend Juanjo.
author: gabrielpV1966VU
